goal: Make staff invitation acceptance fail closed unless both a verified Auth subject and matching verified Auth email claim are present, without restoring public sign-up or identity linking.

worktree.rule: Preserve all current commits. Do not reset, rebase, switch, stash or clean. This runs before the later CCC-299 gateway/request-handler assignment so the same CORE writer owns the overlap serially.

authority: Q-approved invitation-only policy recorded in onboarding commit 217e752f816dedf1f6c535b073039ab596ef046f
D90 identity binding and existing invite-token concealment
allowedWrites: packages/core/src/gateway.ts at acceptStaffInvite and its exact type boundary only
apps/api/test/staff-invites.contract.test.ts only where unauthenticated acceptance behavior changes
readOnly: all other gateway and request-handler routes
excluded: public signUp, PUBLIC_SIGNUP_ENABLED and participant public_signup policy
Auth invitation issuance, service-role credentials, settings, email templates, TTL changes and orphan cleanup
first-admin scripts, callback UI, installation trust, migrations, dependencies, lockfile, deployment and external services
requiredBehavior: The accept route requires the existing signed Bearer verification path. It passes a subject to the gateway only when a nonblank verified subject exists and the verified Auth email claim equals the normalized invitation email.

No credential or a verified email mismatch must produce no users row, no role grant and no invite consumption. Preserve public token concealment by returning the existing not_found-shaped failure rather than revealing which check failed.
A forged or invalid credential remains an authentication failure from the verifier and also creates or consumes nothing.

acceptStaffInvite no longer accepts or defaults a nullable subject for successful registration. It rechecks a nonblank opaque subject before the atomic batch. Keep invite token, expiry, issuer, duplicate email, role and audit checks unchanged.
Successful matching verified subject and email still atomically creates one active user with auth_subject, grants only invited roles and consumes the invite once. Replay remains rejected.

Do not log or return subject, token, provider body or verification detail. Preserve the existing successful 201 response's normalized email because the current client contract consumes it; refusal bodies and logs must not include email.
verification: Use LSP references on acceptStaffInvite before changing its exported signature when available and migrate every current caller.

Run only invite-identity-binding.test.ts and the affected staff-invites.contract.test.ts cases. Prove matching success, missing credential refusal, email mismatch refusal, forged credential refusal and no user/role/invite mutation on every refusal.

Commit only allowed explicit paths locally. Do not bypass configured hooks; if a hook requires out-of-scope work, stop before commit and report it. Do not push, merge, deploy or contact external services.
report: Print marker, parent and commit SHA, changed paths, exact checks, zero-mutation evidence and blocker.
